name: Río Abiseo National Park
description: Río Abiseo National Park protects a vast stretch of Andean cloud forest in Peru's San Martín region. It shelters the yellow-tailed woolly monkey, once thought extinct and found nowhere else, along with many other species that live only here. Dozens of pre-Inca ruins sit on the forested slopes, from 2,500 to 4,000 metres up. The park has been closed to tourists since 1986 to protect it.
